LanguageData.LP_BehemothKin.label: behemoth scion
LanguageData.LP_BehemothKin.description: The blood of an ancient behemoth runs in a human body: they grow year after year until they are as large as ten people, becoming true behemoths; they do not age and cannot be killed - as long as the brain remains, even the worst wound is only a long sleep. The bloodline is passed on to children.
LanguageData.LP_BehemothKin.descriptionShort: Inheritable race. Body size grows every year up to 10 (health, melee, carrying and stomach capacity rise with it), gaining the trait "behemoth" at the top; never ages, and cannot die unless the brain is destroyed.
